sendRedirect.d: redirect the user following a user submit operation. Use this to automatically redirect the user to the next logical step.

p.d: the response object used to communicate back to the user's client

setLabel.d: set the label for this field. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

setAlias.d: set the alias used to set the value for this field. Defaults to field name. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

p.d: column used to populate the field (mostly relevant when populating sublist fields)

setDefaultValue.d: set the default value for this field. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

setMandatory.d: make this field mandatory. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

p.d: if true then field becomes mandatory

setMaxLength.d: set the maxlength for this field (only valid for certain field types). This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

setDisplayType.d: set the display type for this field. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

setBreakType.d: set the break type (startcol|startrow|none) for this field. startrow is only used for fields with a layout type of outside This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

p.d: break type used to add a break in flow layout for this field: startcol|startrow|none

setLayoutType.d: set the layout type and optionally the break type. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

setLinkText.d: set the text that gets displayed in lieu of the field value for URL fields.

p.d: user-friendly display value in lieu of URL

setDisplaySize.d: set the width and height for this field. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

setPadding.d: set the amount of emppty vertical space (rows) between this field and the previous field. This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

p.d: # of empty rows to display above field

setHelpText.d: set help text for this field. If inline is set on assistant pages, help is displayed inline below field This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

p.d: field level help content (rich text) for field
if true then in addition to the popup field help, the help will also be displayed inline below field (supported on assistant pages only)

addSelectOption.d: add a select option to this field (valid for select/multiselect fields). This method is only supported on scripted fields via the UI Object API

p.d: internal ID for this select option
display value for this select option
if true then this select option will be selected by default

getSelectOptions.d: This method can only be used in server contexts against a record object. Also note that a call to this method may return different results for the same field for different roles.

p.d: A search string to filter the select options that are returned.
Supported operators are contains | is | startswith. If not specified, defaults to the contains operator.

setLabel.d: set the label for this sublist. This method is only supported on sublists via the UI Object API

setHelpText.d: set helper text for this sublist. This method is only supported on sublists via the UI Object API

setDisplayType.d: set the displaytype for this sublist: hidden|normal. This method is only supported on scripted or staticlist sublists via the UI Object API

setLineItemValue.d: set the value of a cell in this sublist.

setLineItemValues.d: set values for multiple lines (Array of nlobjSearchResults or name-value pair Arrays) in this sublist. Note that this method is only supported on scripted sublists via the UI Object API

getLineItemCount.d: Return the number of lines in a sublist.

addField.d: add a field (column) to this sublist.

p.d: script ID or internal ID for source list used for this select field

setUniqueField.d: designate a field on sublist that must be unique across all lines (only supported on sublists of type inlineeditor, editor).

p.d: the name of a field on this sublist whose value must be unique across all lines

addButton.d: add a button to this sublist.

addRefreshButton.d: add "Refresh" button to sublists of type "staticlist" to support manual refreshing of the sublist (without entire page reloads) if it's contents are very volatile

addMarkAllButtons.d: add "Mark All" and "Unmark All" buttons to this sublist of type "list".

getLineItemValue.d: Designates a particular column as the totalling column, which is used to calculate and display a running total for the sublist

p.d: The internal ID name of the field on this sublist used to calculate running total

setLabel.d: set the header name for this column.

setURL.d: set the base URL (optionally defined per row) for this column.

p.d: the base URL or a column in the datasource that returns the base URL for each row
if true then the 1st arg is expected to be a column in the datasource

addParamToURL.d: add a URL parameter (optionally defined per row) to this column's URL.

p.d: the name of a parameter to add to URL
the value of the parameter to add to URL -or- a column in the datasource that returns the parameter value for each row
if true then the 2nd arg is expected to be a column in the datasource

setLabel.d: set the label for this tab or subtab.

p.d: string used as label for this tab or subtab

setHelpText.d: set helper text for this tab or subtab.

p.d: inline help text used for this tab or subtab

setLabel.d: set the label for this assistant step.

p.d: display label used for this assistant step

setHelpText.d: set helper text for this assistant step.

p.d: inline help text to display on assistant page for this step

getStepNumber.d: return the index of this step in the assistant page (1-based)
getStepNumber.rd: the index of this step in the assistant (1-based) based on the order in which the steps were added.

getFieldValue.d: return the value of a field entered by the user during this step.

getFieldValues.d: return the selected values of a multi-select field as an Array entered by the user during this step.

getLineItemCount.d: return the number of lines previously entered by the user in this step (or -1 if the sublist does not exist).

getLineItemValue.d: return the value of a sublist field entered by the user during this step.

getAllFields.d: return an array of the names of all fields entered by the user during this step.

getAllLineItems.d: return an array of the names of all sublists entered by the user during this step.

getAllLineItemFields.d: return an array of the names of all sublist fields entered by the user during this step

setLabel.d: set the label for this field group.

setCollapsible.d: set collapsibility property for this field group.

p.d: if true then this field group is collapsible
if true and the field group is collapsible, collapse this field group by default

setSingleColumn.d: set singleColumn property for this field group.

p.d: if true then this field group is displayed in single column

setShowBorder.d: set showBorder property for this field group.

p.d: if true then this field group shows border including label of group

setLabel.d: set the label for this button.

p.d: if true then this button should be disabled on the page

setVisible.d: Sets the button as hidden in the UI. This API is supported on custom buttons and on some standard NetSuite buttons

p.d: Defaults to true if not set. If set to false, the button will be hidden in the UI.

getId.d: return internal ID for select option

getText.d: return display value for select option.
